summary: Verified the upload-binding fix end-to-end: backend /api/upload/data now returns bound_rows/dashboard/warning/bound_tenant_id correctly for each source, and the UploadModal gives honest source-aware toasts + a result panel with upload-bound-rows and upload-warning. All 4 UI scenarios pass; all 6 pytest cases pass; DB cleaned after tests.

issues: A benign 'ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications' warning is being surfaced as a full-screen CRA/webpack error overlay, which visually blocks the dashboard and any modal actions until dismissed. Not a functional bug but very noisy for users; consider swallowing that specific warning in the runtime error listener or setting webpack-dev-server client.overlay.warnings=false / errors filter.

action_items: Optional: suppress ResizeObserver-loop warnings from the CRA/webpack error overlay so the dev preview isn't repeatedly covered by a red overlay (functionality is unaffected).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:465-551 upload_data now correctly discriminates qradar/xsoar/threat_intel and always sets bound_rows/warning/bound_tenant_id — clean.
UploadModal.jsx correctly toast.warning for qradar, toast.success only when bound>0, toast.error when 0 matched, and qc.invalidateQueries() ensures live dashboards refresh without reload.

Small nit: UploadModal reads data.ti_row_count/xsoar_row_count directly for toast logic; server also returns data.bound_rows (source-agnostic). Prefer bound_rows for consistency, but current logic is correct.
seed_data_creation: None. Used /tmp/ti_sample.xlsx, /tmp/xsoar_sample.csv, /tmp/bad_cols.csv as-is. Cleaned uploaded rows via DELETE /api/dashboard/soc-manager/data and DELETE /api/dashboard/threat-intel/data for tenant globalbank at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The upload-binding bug is fixed. Verified: (1) TI xlsx → bound_rows=1, dashboard flips live without reload (kpi-total-advisories=1, ti-data-source-chip visible). (2) XSOAR csv → bound_rows=2, soc-manager becomes live. (3) QRadar (default source) → toast.warning, upload-warning shown, upload-hint-qradar visible, dashboards stay empty. (4) TI + bad_cols.csv → toast.error, upload-warning with '0 rows matched', bound_rows=0. Backend contract validated via pytest.
rca of the issue: Root cause of the original 'upload not reflecting' report was three-fold and now cleanly surfaced to the user: (a) UploadModal defaulted to 'qradar' source, and qradar rows are stored-only (never bound to any dashboard) → previously silent, now toast.warning + upload-hint-qradar + upload-warning. (b) TI/XSOAR parsers silently drop rows whose columns don't match canonical schema, so wrong-header uploads bound 0 rows → now toast.error + upload-warning explaining headers must match. (c) Tenant mismatch was already handled server-side; response now echoes bound_tenant_id so the UI can prove which tenant received data. React Query is invalidated on every successful upload, so live dashboards refresh with no manual reload.
